desc: Reflection skill for agy (Antigravity) sessions running on top of the Opus model. Created 2026-07-03 to close a gap found while building agent-failure-reflection-gate: the reactive gate resolves failures reported with model 'agy-opus' to this canonical id, but no such skill existed yet.
steps: TODO: this skill was created as a placeholder to satisfy agent-failure-reflection-gate's canonical-id convention (see that skill) for the compound model name 'agy-opus'. No agy-on-Opus-specific failure has been recorded here yet -- when one occurs, add a step describing the concrete failure and fix, tagged BUG:/TODO:/IMPROVEMENT: per the convention documented in agent-failure-reflection-gate.

CORRECTION 2026-07-03 (user-verified via real agy CLI check): this skill was created on a FALSE PREMISE. agy (Antigravity CLI) does NOT run on top of Claude Opus/Sonnet/Haiku at all -- it exclusively runs on Google's Gemini model family (confirmed via ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json showing a Gemini model, and no Claude-backend config anywhere). The compound model name 'agy-opus' this skill was created for CANNOT actually occur in practice. DO NOT add real content here expecting an agy-on-Opus failure -- it will never happen. The correct agy compound skills are agy-gemini-flash-reflection / agy-gemini-pro-reflection / agy-root-reflection. Lesson: verify a tool's actual supported-model list via its real CLI/config BEFORE creating a placeholder skill for an assumed model combination -- an unverified assumption (even one repeated by the user in passing) can be wrong.
